research.why: Anthropic/Theorem headline numbers (239 entry points, ~180M lines of Rocq, 'always exits') are all company claims, and the released artifacts show gaps (no halts proofs, 60 of 239 entry points public, narrower LZO check). A claims table with analysis fits; qa and explainer are alternatives but the contrast table is the sharpest shape. Writer: say 'never crashes on covered inputs', not 'always exits'.

news.why: The topic is easy to misread (policy covers RL training/evaluation sandboxes and an offline cached web, not web-data pretraining), and the debate is contested (why not a true air gap, cost, self-reported red-teaming). 4-6 reader questions let us correct the framing first. Title in topics.json is misleading; use the accurate framing. Timeline avoided: used for news on Oct 21.

invention.why: Enron Brain is a numbers-rich demo (45,047 emails, 214 pages, 49,401 facts, 37 of 62,205 quotes failed, 466/500 supported, 48/50 human agreement, ~$11,215). Figures plus an honest caveat on AI-judging-AI and training-data leakage. Explainer not used (kept off this issue); comparison used on Sep 30 and Oct 7.
